A '''Separatist outpost''' constructed on the moon [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] was the sight of the [[Force Harvester]]s first test in over a millennia against [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings, as well as surrounding wild life in the general area on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]].
